SUBJECTIVE: 58 y/o F presents for 3-month diabetes follow-up. Reports adherence to metformin 1000 mg BID since 2016. Denies polyuria, polydipsia. No history of pancreatitis. Family history negative for thyroid cancer.
OBJECTIVE: BP 132/78, BMI 31.2. Labs 06/01/2026: HbA1c 8.2%, eGFR 72 mL/min/1.73m2, LDL 98.
ASSESSMENT: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (E11.9), suboptimal control on monotherapy.
PLAN: Discuss add-on therapy options. Recheck A1c in 3 months.

HPI: 71-year-old man with long-standing type 2 diabetes complicated by CKD stage 3b. Currently on insulin glargine 24 units nightly and metformin 500 mg daily (dose reduced for renal function). Hospitalized 2021 for acute pancreatitis, gallstone related, s/p cholecystectomy.
LABS (05/20/2026): A1c 9.1%, eGFR 38.
IMPRESSION: T2DM with nephropathy; continue current regimen.

diagnoses.name: Type 2 diabetes mellitus with diabetic chronic kidney disease

text: Pt is a 44 yo female seen for annual physical. PMH: prediabetes (A1c 6.1% last year), obesity. No medications. Mother has hypothyroidism. Counseled on diet and exercise. Labs today: A1c 6.3%, eGFR >90.

ENDOCRINOLOGY CONSULT NOTE
Patient: 63M. Referred for T2DM management. Metformin 1000 mg BID x 4 yrs, empagliflozin 10 mg added 2024. Started semaglutide 0.25 mg weekly six weeks ago, tolerating well. No personal history of pancreatitis. Family history: father with medullary thyroid carcinoma diagnosed at 70.
Recent labs (06/10/2026): HbA1c 7.6%, eGFR 64.
Plan: continue titration.

S: 52 y/o M, type 2 diabetes dx 2019, here for med refill. Takes metformin ER 1500 mg nightly. Denies GI side effects. No hx pancreatitis. No family hx thyroid disease.
O: Wt 98 kg. A1c 7.9% (05/2026). Creatinine 0.9, eGFR 88.
A/P: T2DM, above goal. Reinforce lifestyle. Consider second agent.
22-year-old woman with type 1 diabetes since age 9 on insulin pump therapy (aspart). One DKA admission in 2020. A1c 7.4% in May. eGFR normal. Presents for pump supply renewal.

PROGRESS NOTE. 67F with T2DM (dx 2011), HTN, hyperlipidemia. Meds: metformin 1000 BID, atorvastatin 40, amlodipine 5. Previously on liraglutide, discontinued 2024 due to nausea. Denies pancreatitis. FHx: sister with breast cancer.
Labs 06/2026: HbA1c 10.4%, eGFR 58.
Plan: intensify therapy; discuss options.

Chief complaint: fatigue. 49 yo male. History of type 2 diabetes managed with diet alone after metformin was stopped in 2025 for intolerance. Chronic pancreatitis secondary to alcohol use, in remission, followed by GI. A1c 7.2% two months ago. eGFR 81.

S: 39 y/o F with T2DM x 2 years, on metformin 850 mg BID. Also on sitagliptin 100 mg. Works nights. No pancreatitis, no thyroid disease in family.
O: BMI 34. A1c 8.8% (06/08/2026). eGFR 94.
A/P: Uncontrolled T2DM. Eligible for study referral per patient interest.
78-year-old man, type 2 diabetes on metformin 500 mg BID and glipizide. Lives independently. Denies pancreatitis. Labs: A1c 7.5%, eGFR 52 (04/2026). Discussed hypoglycemia precautions.

Telehealth visit. 55 y/o F, T2DM since 2017, on metformin 1000 mg BID. Reports good adherence. No GI complaints. Denies personal or family history of thyroid cancer or MEN2. No pancreatitis. Most recent labs not yet available; last A1c on file 8.0% from 11/2025. eGFR 77 at that time.

ED follow-up. 60M with type 2 diabetes, seen in ED last week for hyperglycemia (glucose 410) without ketoacidosis. Started on insulin detemir at discharge in addition to metformin 1000 mg BID. A1c 11.2%. eGFR 69. No history of pancreatitis or thyroid disease.
